summary: Sysco Corporation and co-issuer Sysco Holdings Corporation filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting issuance of $10.75B USD senior notes, $3.9B USD junior subordinated notes, and €1.0B euro junior subordinated notes, raising roughly $10.64B, $3.8B, and €0.99B net of discounts and expenses. Proceeds fund part of the cash consideration for the pending acquisition of JRD Unico, Inc. and Warehouse Realty, LLC; absent closing, a special mandatory redemption applies (except the 2036 senior notes). Watch financing conditions and acquisition completion risk, though this filing itself is a debt offering, not the deal event.
